items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Yeah, me and George Gayno was a drummer. I was playing the piano. George was playing a ton of guitar and this fellow was playing the drum.

ctx.x: Wait a minute, was that you and George Gayno, you say?

What? Playing at the ballet? Yeah, me and George Gayno was a drummer. I was playing the piano. George was playing a ton of guitar and this fellow was playing the drum. And he was interlocking, you know what I mean? Full of talking his throat. Yeah. I just couldn't make out, you know. And then every time somebody would come in, well then he'd say something about him and, you know, make the crowd laugh and all that kind of stuff. And that's how we played there most, you know, until we, until they, after the song I…
